description: This file is a PHP script for executing search functionalities within the TestLink test management system. It handles search inputs, performs queries on test suites, requirements, test cases, and other entities, and renders the results in formatted tables. It includes functions for building HTML tables with search results and manages interactions with other components via required class files.

classes.name: tlExtTable
classes.description: A class representing a customized HTML table used for rendering search results with features like grouping, sorting, and toolbar options.

methods.name: buildTCExtTable
methods.description: Builds and returns an extended table object displaying test case search results, with options for grouping and sorting.

methods.name: buildTSExtTable
methods.description: Builds and returns an extended table object displaying test suite search results with sortable columns.

methods.name: buildRSExtTable
methods.description: Builds and returns an extended table object for requirement specifications search results.

methods.name: buildRQExtTable
methods.description: Builds and returns an extended table object for requirement search results, including links for revisions.

methods.name: cleanUpTarget
methods.description: Sanitizes and prepares a set of target strings for database queries.
